planets.name: Wolf 327 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Wolf 327 with a 0.573-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: Wolf 327 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Wolf 327. Its orbit and size follow Murgas et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
